en.headline: Customs seize about 7000 counterfeit items in operation against fake watches
en.dek: A 15-day special operation codenamed Time Shield targeted cross-border transshipment of counterfeit watches and netted goods worth about HK$7.6 million, with one person arrested.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it conducted a special operation codenamed Time Shield from 28 September to 13 October to combat the cross-border transshipment of counterfeit watches.

Officers seized about 7,000 suspected counterfeit and infringing items, including watches, clothing and mobile phones, with an estimated market value of about HK$7.6 million. One person was arrested during the operation.
Customs said it would provide further details of the case later. The action forms part of ongoing efforts against intellectual property crime involving goods moving through Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 海關「時盾」行動檢獲約7000件冒牌貨 拘一人
zh.dek: 海關上月28日至本月13日採取特別行動打擊跨境轉運冒牌手錶，檢獲約7000件懷疑冒牌及侵權貨物，估計市值約760萬元。
body: 香港海關表示，上月28日至本月13日採取代號「時盾」的特別行動，打擊跨境轉運冒牌手錶活動。
行動中檢獲約7000件懷疑冒牌及侵權貨物，包括手錶、衣服及手機等，估計市值共約760萬元，並拘捕一人。
海關表示稍後會交代案情。是次行動屬打擊經香港轉運的侵權貨物持續工作的一部分。
